sources.title: Run the WUIC coding model locally - WUIC Framework
sources.snippet: Download qwen3-coder-wuic:30b-dpo — our DPO fine-tune of qwen3-coder for the WUIC framework — from Hugging Face, run it on your own GPU with Ollama, and wire it into the WUIC backend and the WUIC Assistant VS Code extension. Fully local, no API calls.
